title: Corporate Gym Discounts in NZ — How to Get a Cheaper Membership Through Work
meta_desc: Save on gym membership with corporate discounts in NZ, available through employee wellness programmes
intro: Many New Zealand employers offer corporate gym discounts as part of their employee wellness programmes, with savings of up to 20% off standard gym membership prices. For instance, a typical gym membership at Les Mills NZ costs around $34.95 per week, but with a corporate discount, you could pay as little as $27.96 per week. To get started, it's essential to understand how these discounts work and how to negotiate a better rate with your employer.

sections.heading: How Corporate Gym Discounts Work
sections.body: Corporate gym discounts are available through partnerships between gyms and employers, such as NZHL and Southern Cross. These partnerships allow employees to access discounted gym memberships, promoting a healthier and more productive workforce. Typical contract terms range from 6 to 12 months, with prices varying depending on the gym and location.

sections.heading: Negotiating a Corporate Rate with Your Employer
sections.body: To negotiate a corporate rate with your employer, start by researching the standard prices and corporate discounts offered by gyms in your area. You can then approach your HR department with a proposal, highlighting the benefits of a corporate gym discount programme for employee wellness and productivity. Be prepared to discuss the costs and potential savings for your employer.
